scenes.title: The Definition of Fear
scenes.summary: Fear is pain or disturbance arising from the imagination of a future evil, destructive or painful, and near at hand; people do not fear death while it seems far off. Danger is the approach of something fearful.

scenes.title: What Is Fearful
scenes.summary: Fearful are the enmity and anger of those who can act, injustice and outraged virtue when they have power, those who know one's crimes, the wronged and those who have wronged, rivals, the powerful, and the calm and crafty more than the hot-tempered; in short, what is pitiable when it happens to others.

scenes.title: Who Feels Fear
scenes.summary: Only those who expect to suffer feel fear; the very prosperous and those who think they have suffered everything do not. A speaker who wants his hearers afraid must make them think they could suffer as others have.

scenes.title: Confidence
scenes.summary: Confidence is the opposite of fear, the hope of safety as near and of danger as absent or far off; people are confident when help is at hand, when they have often succeeded or escaped, when they have done no wrong, and when their relations with the gods are good.
